$comment: Traceability: worker authentication model, worker-service-seam.md §5. First frame on a new worker socket connection; the service closes the connection if it does not arrive within 5s.

msg_type.description: Wire discriminator: names the message type. Added in the Phase 1 edit (2026-09-18); the Phase 0 schemas pinned no discriminator, and service.error already used "message" for human-readable text, so routing on "message" was impossible.

worker_pid.description: Worker process id; the service cross-checks it against SO_PEERCRED.

worker_token.description: Boot-issued 256-bit token, base64url no padding. Issued per worker spawn; dies with the worker.

worker_version.description: Worker build version, informational only; never authorizes anything.
